name: The Last Aster
source:
As the war grows more serious, the people of Hyacinth begin preparing for a desperate new future. All able men above the age of 18 are being called to perform their duties and join the war effort. It is Cedar’s last weekend with his lover, Aster, before he too goes off to fight for his country. Follow the couple as they say their goodbyes in this heart wrenching love story that was made in one month for NaNoRenO 2023.

[From [url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/the-last-aster]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
戰事愈發嚴峻，Hyacinth的居民開始為毫無希望的新未來做準備。所有年滿18歲、身體健全的男性都被徵召入伍，履行職責，投身戰爭。Cedar也即將為國出征，這是他與愛人Aster共度的最後一個週末。跟隨這對戀人，見證他們的告別。本作是一段令人心碎的愛情故事，為NaNoRenO2023活動歷時一個月製作而成。

[摘自[url=https://legendex-games.itch.io/the-last-aster]itch.io[/url]]
